title: REQ · Worker config validation rejects invalid execution settings with field-naming errors
summary: LoadFS validates timeout, retries, budget and provider kind
description: Context: LoadFS validates only repo_path. Desired behavior: after defaults, reject negative execution_timeout, negative max_retries, negative max_budget and a provider_kind other than mock or claude. Expected result: error text contains the YAML key name and config is nil. Why: fail fast on a misconfigured worker.
acceptance_criteria: Given execution_timeout of -1m, max_retries of -1, max_budget of -1 or provider_kind of gpt, when LoadFS runs, then it returns a nil config and an error containing execution_timeout, max_retries, max_budget or provider_kind respectively
Given provider_kind mock or claude with non-negative numbers, when LoadFS runs, then no error is returned
technical_constraints: Validation runs after defaults so zero values still default
definition_of_done: Invalid values rejected with key-naming errors
